regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and the allene-relay claim were reviewed. The article says SI is available online, but the workspace supplies no SI file and source_mapping marks association unestablished.
Panel a is generic prior-work reaction-class context; panel b is the generic current-work proposal. They are classified as one general-scheme record, not preparative experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1-10, and footnotes a-h
regions.finding: Ten independent optimization rows were retained with row scale, nucleophile amount, catalyst/ligand, base, additive, solvent, temperature, 12 h time, crude-NMR yields, and the entry-1 isolated yield.

Reproduction of Table 2 entry 4 and Table 3 entries 2 and 10 was attached as context to those existing rows; no duplicate experiments were created because no independent conditions or outcomes are given.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 structures do not define unique molecules.
SI association remains unestablished; optimization workups and most isolated masses are unavailable.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: Narrative interpretation of all ten Table 1 rows and selection of standard conditions; linked to the existing row records without duplication.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2 drawing, rows 1-9, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Nine carbon-nucleophile scope experiments were retained row-by-row with shared catalyst/base/solvent conditions, row scales/times/solvent overrides, and isolated yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 drawing, rows 1-11, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Eleven carbonate-scope experiments were retained separately with R-group labels, row times, isolated yields, DMF/90 °C overrides, and ca. 6% minor Z isomer for entries 6-7.
Distinct enantioenriched (R)-1m experiment: standard Pd/K3PO4/DMSO conditions, 24 h, (S)-5ma in 80% with 99.5:0.5 e.r.; not merged with Table 3 entry 10.
Text introduces the two proposed pathways drawn as Scheme 2 on page 3; classified as mechanism rather than observed experiments.

unresolved: Most scope rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Complex structures and stereochemical assignments remain machine-unverified.
No SI file is supplied or associated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 and adjacent mechanism text
regions.finding: Two possible pathways through I1/I3 or I1/I4/I5 were classified as a proposed mechanism; control experiments favor path a, but intermediates remain unisolated.
Two distinct controls retained: no-base monocyclization to 3aa (86% isolated, 70 °C, 1 h) and one-pot two-step formation of 5aa (80%; 1 h then K3PO4/11 h).
Two SI-referenced results visible in the main text were retained without reconstructing the absent SI: entry 2 gives 5aa 54% by 1H NMR plus 6aa; entry 4 with 2 equiv MeOH gives 5aa 83% and trace 6aa.
Proposed A-D pathway rationalizing protonation versus C-N cleavage; classified as mechanism rather than independent experiments.
Text introduces the one-pot two-step axial-to-central chirality-transfer series whose three explicit rows are drawn on page 4; records cite both pages.

unresolved: Table S1 and Scheme S1 in the SI are unavailable; hidden row conditions were not inferred.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed rather than isolated.
Scheme 4 configurations are tentative and structures remain unverified.

regions.finding: Three distinct axial-to-central chirality-transfer experiments were read from the original image: (R)-1o/2a to (S)-5oa, (R)-1o/2b to (S)-5ob, and (R)-1p/2b to (S)-5pb, with their two-stage times/temperatures, yields, and e.r. values.

regions.region: page 4 left-column Experimental Section typical synthesis of 5aa
regions.finding: Detailed 0.3 mmol preparation (quantities/purities, Ar, 70 °C/12 h, workup, chromatography, 102.1 mg, 79%) matches Table 2 entry 1 and was merged into that record rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 4 remaining conclusion, characterization, and references 1-11
regions.finding: Conclusion and product characterization support the reported chemistry but do not define additional reaction experiments; cited literature was not imported.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits scale, solvent volume, workup/purification, yield basis, and e.r. method.
No SI file was supplied or associated; complex structures remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 5 full page, references 11-17 and SI cross-reference
regions.finding: The original page image contains bibliography and a reference to Supporting Information only. It contains no current-paper reaction arrow, table row, or experimental procedure, so no record was created.
